parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the 'Wallpaper' package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and therefore carries sample-app semantics. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a sample-app file warrants no-action. The duplication of 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator' in the sample app is a deliberate mirror of the production type in 'DebugPanel', not a consolidation opportunity — lifting it would couple production 'DebugPanel' code to demonstration-context semantics.
